newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residue up, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residue up, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks rose by 20,000 barrels in the week ended January 22 to 10.094 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.

Middle-distillate stocks rose a hefty 2.134 million barrels to 8.677 million barrels, its highest level since the week ended November 13 1996 at 9.018 million barrels. Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks fell 491,000 barrels to 5.42 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3084)
